headline: Result Update

highlights: Northern Arc Capital reported its highest-ever quarterly PAT of INR 129 Cr.
PAT (ex-NCI) rose 41% YoY to INR 129 Cr in Q2 FY27, up from INR 92 Cr in Q2 FY26.
Gross transaction volume for the quarter was INR 13,708 Cr, up about 57% YoY from INR 8,757 Cr.
For H1 FY27, PAT rose 41% YoY to INR 244 Cr, RoE was 12.0% and book value per share was INR 260 (+15%).
valuation: It achieved a first close of INR 400 Cr for its Diversified Debt Fund (target size INR 2,000 Cr) and launched its first open-ended private credit fund, the Savings Plus fund.

Valuation call: Given its strong earnings growth trajectory, robust AUM outlook on a low base, and ROE recovery to ~15.7 % by FY29E, we maintain with a BUY rating and a price target of INR 393.6 (1.1x FY29E P/ABV), implying 43.6 % from INR 274 over the next 24 months.

Management Guidance on Future Performance: • AUM Growth & Channel Mix: Full-year FY27 AUM growth is guided at 23% to 25% (with management aiming for upward of 25% given strong festive demand), while the Direct- to-Customer (D2C) mix is projected to reach ~70% of total AUM by year-end. • Profitability & Margins (ROA & NIM): Exit ROA is targeted at ~3.0% by the end of FY27 and 3.4% to 3.5% for FY28.
watch: We anticipate growth across key financial metrics over the next few years.
